title: Dr. Brett Cohen agrees the Great Pyramid made sulfuric acid

tellings.quote: He also agrees that the Great Pyramid was producing sulfuric acid, although completely different mechanisms of operation and stages of a reaction.

plain: A scientist named Dr. Brett Cohen is said to agree that the Great Pyramid of Giza once worked as a chemical plant making sulfuric acid. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who argues the pyramid was built to produce chemicals, tells Michels this, and adds that Cohen pictures "completely different mechanisms of operation and stages of a reaction." If true, it would mean someone else with a scientific background backs Drumm's idea that the pyramid was a machine and not a tomb.
